svg.title: Medical imaging · Multimodal foundation models · Research agents
svg.desc: An original animated research illustration on a light background. Medical volumes and text inform multimodal foundation models. A floating single-lens research companion uses tools beside a clinician in a Mayo Clinic imaging setting. A compact compute shelf represents large-scale parallel software; extensive agent application experience is also highlighted. Scanning, feature alignment, tool activity and a returning research-feedback signal loop over eight seconds. This is a conceptual research illustration, not patient data, a clinical result, a claim that the researcher is a physician, or an institutional endorsement.
svg.text: Learning across images and text · Reasoning with research agents
